items.title: Russian court sentences anti-war politician Shlosberg to 11 years in jail
items.description: Prominent Russian opposition politician Lev Shlosberg has repeatedly called for a ceasefire in Ukraine and was charged over his participation in an online debate on the war as well as for sharing critical articles about it.
